title: Productize physics capture and substep replay
requires: CUDA reference device; public API and Gallery test harness
scope: Turn the retained Gallery debug capture into a backend-neutral, versioned capture and replay path that can reproduce a selected substep without driver-private access.
acceptance: Specify capture provenance, resource identity, partial-data behavior and schema versioning; use the public API or common support code rather than driver internals.
Round-trip the archived over-top rigid state and reproduce its 1/240-second check on current CUDA with focused negative and compatibility tests.
